# AiSources

```ts
import { AiSources } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

Where an AI answer came from: a "Sources:" lead-in and a list of links to each origin. Use it under assistant replies (usually through AiMessageResponse's sources prop) whenever the answer draws on documents or pages.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sources` | `AiSource[]` | **required** | The sources an answer drew on, in order. |
| `heading` | `string` | `'Sources:'` | Lead-in text. |

Also accepts all `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<AiSources sources={[{ label: 'Product guide', href: '/guide' }, { label: 'Release notes', href: '/notes' }]} />
<AiSources heading="Based on:" sources={sources} />
```

## Design tokens used

`--color-text-icon-secondary`, `--type-size-caption`, `--color-text-icon-link`, `--space-050`

## Accessibility

- Sources are a real list of links (<ul>), named "Sources", so screen-reader users hear how many there are.
- Each link names its source — never "link" or a raw URL.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Link each source to its origin | List sources as plain text |
| Keep labels short ("Product guide") | Paste long URLs as labels |
| Show only the sources the answer used | Pad the list with loosely related pages |
